description: This PHP class 'EmbeddedURLForYoutube' is part of a Human Resource Management system plugin. It extends an abstract class to process YouTube URLs, validating and converting them into embedded URL formats suitable for embedding videos.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForYoutube
classes.description: A class that extracts and converts YouTube URLs into embed URLs, with regex validation.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embed URL for a YouTube video if the provided URL is valid; throws an exception otherwise.
